windows.command: py -3 -m venv .venv; .\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install --upgrade pip; .\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

linux.command: python3 -m venv .venv && ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

osx.command: python3 -m venv .venv && ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
